name: Sorghum
siboNotes: Naturally gluten-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diet. Contains resistant starch which may benefit gut health when tolerated.
preparationTips: Rinse grain before cooking to remove any debris
Cook in 3:1 water to sorghum ratio for about 45-60 minutes
Can be popped like popcorn for a crunchy snack
Grind into flour for gluten-free baking applications
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants and phenolic compounds
Good source of iron and B vitamins
